name: Prince George’s County 2024–25 regular MCAP district comparison
model_scope: Prince George’s County independent 2024–25 regular MCAP grade-school district models: exact operational NCES LEA 2400510 / CCD native MD-16 / MSDE 16 identities. All 159 native E/M/EM profiles with positive September grades 3–8 and no high-grade row remain searchable. Original regular School_Level All Students All Grades Levels 3/4 published rates support 146 Math, 159 ELA and 146 independently fitted Combined results; 13 Math masks retain ELA. Precise same-year individual Early Attendance ratios use their own denominators. Accelerated Math courses and the applicable grade 6–7 waiver remain in native totals; DLM stays separate. High, mixed, primary, unknown, unmatched and closed records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Prince George’s County source release.

income_definition.definition: Same-year individual direct certification from MSDE Early Attendance: SNAP/FSP, TANF/TCA, foster care, Medicaid and other qualifying categorical statuses. Use the native Economically Disadvantaged count and its Total Student Cnt denominator, not FARMS, meal access, a CEP multiplier or a tested subgroup. The native Early Attendance denominator differs from the September30 enrollment file; September grades establish school scope only. Suppressed or ranged income remains unavailable, with no complement reconstruction or prior-year backfill. Use individual Economically Disadvantaged Cnt divided by its own Early Attendance Total Student Cnt, reconciling the published one-decimal percentage within0.0500001 percentage point. Keep the native whole-school All row for multiband schools; a lone band row establishes the complete native school income record. Never replace with September/CCD enrollment, FARMS, participation, tested subgroup or another year. The collection as-of date is unspecified in the pinned definition.

methodology.summary: Prince George’s County independent regular MCAP grade-school district models with individual Early Attendance income; valid-score count scope and ten-valid-scored floor uncertified, sampling intervals unavailable.
details: Prince George’s County independent 2024–25 regular MCAP grade-school district models: exact operational NCES LEA 2400510 / CCD native MD-16 / MSDE 16 identities. All 159 native E/M/EM profiles with positive September grades 3–8 and no high-grade row remain searchable. Original regular School_Level All Students All Grades Levels 3/4 published rates support 146 Math, 159 ELA and 146 independently fitted Combined results; 13 Math masks retain ELA. Precise same-year individual Early Attendance ratios use their own denominators. Accelerated Math courses and the applicable grade 6–7 waiver remain in native totals; DLM stays separate. High, mixed, primary, unknown, unmatched and closed records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.

Three separate unweighted OLS fits reproduce all 451 audited results and explicit centered deleted fits. Combined independently fits the paired 146 original Math/ELA rate means, with its own scale and studentization. ELA has 159 members, so neither coefficients nor studentized scores can be averaged across subject models. Filters never refit models. Associations do not establish causal effectiveness or overall quality.

Use only native regular School_Level Year2025 Student Group=All Students Mathematics All Grades or English Language Arts All Grades published Proficient Pct, preserving its leading/trailing whitespace raw. Original MSDE reportcard assessment notes establish proficiency as Levels3/4 under the regular four-level ELA/math standards introduced in2021–22. Native All Grades Math includes accelerated high-school course tests at middle schools, including Algebra1/Geometry/Algebra2, instead of averaging grades or substituting grade3–8 tests. Alternate DLM is a separate collection and never enters regular MCAP. High/mixed populations remain unreleased.

The original March2025 MCAP overview documents March17,2025 grade6–7 high-school-course waiver for2024–25 through2027–28. Course row presence does not certify student participation: preserve numeric and starred Algebra1/Geometry/Algebra2 counts separately. Original native All Grades totals, not component sums or averaged grade percentages, are the prospective outcomes.

Same-year individual direct certification from MSDE Early Attendance: SNAP/FSP, TANF/TCA, foster care, Medicaid and other qualifying categorical statuses. Use the native Economically Disadvantaged count and its Total Student Cnt denominator, not FARMS, meal access, a CEP multiplier or a tested subgroup. The native Early Attendance denominator differs from the September30 enrollment file; September grades establish school scope only. Suppressed or ranged income remains unavailable, with no complement reconstruction or prior-year backfill.

Use individual Economically Disadvantaged Cnt divided by its own Early Attendance Total Student Cnt, reconciling the published one-decimal percentage within0.0500001 percentage point. Keep the native whole-school All row for multiband schools; a lone band row establishes the complete native school income record. Never replace with September/CCD enrollment, FARMS, participation, tested subgroup or another year. The collection as-of date is unspecified in the pinned definition.

All 159 individual income ratios use their own Early Attendance numerator and denominator. Multiband native E/M/EM profiles use the unique whole-school All row, never summed bands or September/CCD/another-year replacement. September district and known-school totals 132,151 differ from CCD 132,123 by 28; an unmatched JACS native entry has 28, which does not prove the cause or authorize an inferred identity. Early Attendance district and known-school sums 133,427 agree while six missing denominator cells remain missing, never zero or allocated.

Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified. Native administrative Tested Count, Early Attendance income denominators, September/CCD enrollment, participation and federal 95%-rule counts never substitute for valid-score denominators. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null; sampling intervals are unavailable. Studentization uses the deleted-school residual scale and N−3 degrees of freedom; it provides no enrollment adjustment or shrinkage. Published one-decimal rates, rounded levels and administrative counts remain distinct; never reconstruct masked rates or valid-scored counts.

Full and all 451 deleted designs have rank two and finite positive scales. Largest deleted prediction changes over observed incomes: Math 3.169599; ELA 2.367381; Combined 2.412570 percentage points. All six eligible charters and influential Glenarden Woods and Imagine Andrews members remain eligible. Diagnostic flags are descriptive; they never exclude a school or clamp a prediction.

The complete source retains 5,404 original records, 89,640 typed cells, original headers and primary definitions. Compact normalized pointers preserve exact row, member, worksheet and field references. Historical audit approvals remain false; only this separately validated grade-school contract is released.

Names, slicing or composition never correct identities: Ellen Ochoa’s original native 16-0218 NCES 24005109050 remains unjoined to CCD 240051090501. Closed, high, mixed, primary, unknown and unmatched scopes stay outside the 159 profiles. Programs are Unclassified; admissions, provider roles, coordinates and boundaries remain unknown. One year only. Incompatible state thresholds and income definitions cannot produce a common national ranking.
